async def run_test():
    _condition_met = False
    _until_retries = 0
    while _until_retries < 10:
        print(f"[until-loop] iteration {_until_retries + 1}/10")
        async with testmu.step('PRIMARY: scroll to the distribution section headed "Distribute your book worldwide"; role=text; text="Distribute your book worldwide"'):
            await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded', timeout=5000)
            await page.evaluate('window.scrollBy(0, 600)')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        if await testmu.check_until_condition(page, 'the heading "Distribute your book worldwide" is visible'):
            _condition_met = True
            break
        _until_retries += 1
    set_var("__result__", {"condition_met": _condition_met, "retries": _until_retries + 1})
